system.description:
You activate the roots of your hair causing your hair to grow at a heightened rate and granting you full control over your hairs movements.

For the duration of this jutsu you can use the following abilities granted by this jutsu.

1 Action.

Wrap. You command your hair to lash out grabbing a creature you can see within 15 feet of you. Make a melee ninjutsu attack. On a success, you restrain them. A Restrained creature makes strength saving throw, escaping on a success. On your turn, as a Bonus action, you can move the Restrained creature anywhere within 15 feet of you as if you were dragging them.

1 Reaction.

Needle Cap. As a reaction to taking damage your hair wraps around your body and harden with spiked, needle-like hair armor. Each time the triggering creature and each creature thereafter makes a melee attack against you while within 10 feet of you, they take 3d6 piercing damage, until the beginning of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage of Needle Cap by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the number of creatures you can target with Wrap by +2 and creatures who take damage a result of Needle Cap gains a rank of Bleed. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the range of Wrap to 30 feet and Needle Cap now affects all creature within a 10-foot radius centered on you each time you are targeted by a melee attack.
